description: query_changes currently ignores filter, sort, up_to_id, max_changes, and collapse_threads. Tests for Email/queryChanges with these arguments silently test unfiltered results, giving false confidence. The parameters need to be implemented in the test backend for the conformance tests to be meaningful. Source: JMAP-bx3z.25 review finding.
title: MemoryBackend::query_changes: implement filter/sort/upToId/maxChanges/collapseThreads
